description: SmartSlicerPro is a flexible slicer visual for Power BI that goes beyond the built-in slicer's limitations. Search with Select All — the built-in slicer loses Select All when you search. SmartSlicerPro's Select All works on your filtered search results, so you can narrow the list, then select or clear everything in one click. Three display modes — Dropdown (click to expand), Hover to expand, or always-open Vertical List. Set in the format pane to match how your report is actually used. Selection modes — Multi-select with a visible Select All row, or Single-select for radio-button-style filtering where only one value can be active at a time. Reset and Apply — the Reset button restores the default state instantly. Apply dismisses the search so you see the full list with your selections intact. Full format-pane control — header typography and alignment, search box colors, selection badge colors, checkbox shape (square or circle), alternating row shading, selected and unselected row colors, background, border, and corner radius. Accessible — supports Windows High Contrast mode and full keyboard navigation (Tab, arrow keys, Enter/Space).
